notablePrerequisites: You do not control another Bird or Scout or have a Bird or Scout in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Aven Surveyor by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Volo triggers, creating a copy of the Aven Surveyor spell.
The Aven Surveyor copy enters, triggering itself.
Holding priority, activate Food Chain by exiling the Aven Surveyor token, adding {U}{U}{U}{U}{U}{U} that can only be spent on creature spells.
Aven Surveyor enters the battlefield, returning itself to your hand.
Repeat.
